data.recap: Crypto is drifting lower on thin conviction rather than selling off. BTC is holding just above $108k with dealer gamma dampening the range, and the majors are following it sideways. Two developments matter: a large exchange listed three Solana memecoins in one batch, and a Base launch platform disclosed a contract bug that froze roughly $4M of LP. Alt volume is concentrated in Solana names, where DEX turnover reclaimed $3B/day. Nothing on the top-10 board moved more than 4% in either direction.

stories.title: Exchange lists three Solana memecoins in a single batch
stories.whyItMatters: Listing flow into memecoins has historically pulled retail volume back onto Solana DEXes within 48h.

stories.title: Base launch platform freezes $4M of LP after contract bug
stories.whyItMatters: Anything launched through that platform in the last week carries an LP-recovery risk that on-chain checks will not see.

stories.title: Solana DEX volume reclaims $3B/day
stories.whyItMatters: Depth is where the flow is; thin books elsewhere are a sizing problem, not a thesis problem.
